possible_duplicates.reason: Open request to have uv run ruff check, either by extending uv check or adding a uv lint command; the body explicitly names uv lint for ruff check.
Open request for a ruff check equivalent to uv format for ruff format, i.e. the same shorthand for linting that this issue asks for.

escalation_reason: Whether uv should add a lint subcommand wrapping ruff check (and how it relates to the existing uv check idea in #19768) is a product decision for maintainers.
rationale: The reporter asks for uv to wrap ruff check as a new command, which is a feature request for behaviour uv does not currently provide, so enhancement matches the template label. No MRE is needed and nothing points at an external defect. search_issues found two open, closely overlapping requests (#19768 and #16314). The docs search returned only docs/guides/tools.md, which did not show a lint command, consistent with it not existing. Escalated because adding the command is a maintainer product decision.
